# Global News Shorts

> Global News Shorts — the important USA and world news, in short videos. Daily clips, straight to the point.

## Clips

- [Fauci Pleads the Fifth](https://globalnewsshorts.com/clips/fauci-pleads-the-fifth/): Sen. Josh Hawley grills Dr. Fauci in a Senate hearing — asking what day of the week it is, what color tie he's wearing — and gets the Fifth Amendment every time. 111 invocations, zero answers.
- [Hawley Grills Fauci on 111 Fifth Amendment Invocations](https://globalnewsshorts.com/clips/hawley-grills-fauci/): Sen. Hawley explains why he asked Dr. Fauci about his tie and the carpet: to test the good faith of 111 Fifth Amendment invocations — including questions with no fear of prosecution. “That is an abuse… there's no privilege for any of that.”
